claims.text: Many reviewers report the unit did not turn on or work at all, even with new batteries.
Several reviewers say the product arrived looking used, with a dirty bowl or water stains.
Positive reviewers say it cleans and dries brushes quickly and well, saving time.
Some reviewers note the brush tubes/attachments don't hold tapered brushes well or brushes don't spin in the water.
A few reviewers mention the motor is weak or that pre-scrubbing is needed for a good clean.
